% K_2 channel kernels (direct form), generated by symbolic.py. ray: int_{eta_*}^{eta_o} d eta of the expression.
% Pperp = k1 k2 (mu - mu1 mu2); E_a = exp(i k_a mu_a chi); EK = E1 E2.
\paragraph{[ray] local / fields:2 [ray]}
\begin{dmath*}
- \frac{EK \left(Hp Kn^{2} k_{1}^{2} \left(k_{1}^{2} + 2 k_{1} k_{2} \mu + k_{2}^{2} \mu^{2}\right) - K^{4} \left(- 2 Hp k_{1}^{2} \mu_{1}^{2} + Hp k_{1}^{2} + 2 i Kn Kom_{12} k_{1} \mu_{1} + 2 i Kn Kom_{21} k_{2} \mu_{2} + 8 i Kn \Psi_{2} + 4 Phi2p - 4 Psi2p\right) + K^{2} \left(Hp Kn^{2} k_{1}^{2} - 4 Hp Kn k_{1}^{3} \mu_{1} - 4 Hp Kn k_{1}^{2} k_{2} \mu \mu_{1} + Hp k_{1}^{4} + 2 Hp k_{1}^{3} k_{2} \mu + Hp k_{1}^{2} k_{2}^{2} \mu^{2} + 2 i Kn^{2} Kom_{12} k_{1}^{2} + 2 i Kn^{2} Kom_{12} k_{1} k_{2} \mu + 2 i Kn^{2} Kom_{21} k_{1} k_{2} \mu + 2 i Kn^{2} Kom_{21} k_{2}^{2}\right)\right)}{4 K^{4}}
\end{dmath*}
\paragraph{[ray] lensing (transverse Dx1) / fields:1 [ray]}
\begin{dmath*}
- 2 i Pperp \left(Dp_{1} E_{2} TPhi_{2} k_{2} \mu_{2} + Dp_{2} E_{1} TPhi_{1} k_{1} \mu_{1}\right)
\end{dmath*}
\paragraph{[ray] time delay (radial Dx1) / fields:1 [ray]}
\begin{dmath*}
- 2 Dz_{1} E_{2} TPhi_{2} k_{2}^{2} \mu_{2}^{2} - 2 Dz_{2} E_{1} TPhi_{1} k_{1}^{2} \mu_{1}^{2}
\end{dmath*}
\paragraph{[ray] transverse direction k1 (aberration+deflection) / fields:1 [ray]}
\begin{dmath*}
2 Pperp \left(E_{1} Kf_{2} TPhi_{1} + E_{2} Kf_{1} TPhi_{2}\right)
\end{dmath*}
\paragraph{[ray] local / fields:1+1 [ray]}
\begin{dmath*}
4 E_{1} E_{2} \left(TPhi_{1} TPhip_{2} + TPhi_{2} TPhip_{1}\right)
\end{dmath*}
\paragraph{[obs] observer clock / fields:1 [obs]}
\begin{dmath*}
2 i E_{1} TPhi_{1} detao_{1 2} k_{1} \mu_{1} + E_{1} TPhip_{1} detao_{1 2} + i E_{1} TVp_{1} detao_{1 2} k_{1} \mu_{1} - E_{1} TdTp_{1} detao_{1 2} + 2 i E_{2} TPhi_{2} detao_{1 1} k_{2} \mu_{2} + E_{2} TPhip_{2} detao_{1 1} + i E_{2} TVp_{2} detao_{1 1} k_{2} \mu_{2} - E_{2} TdTp_{2} detao_{1 1}
\end{dmath*}
\paragraph{[emi] emission-surface shift / fields:1 [emi]}
\begin{dmath*}
- i E_{1} TPhi_{1} detae_{1 2} k_{1} \mu_{1} - E_{1} TPhip_{1} detae_{1 2} - E_{1} TV_{1} detae_{1 2} k_{1}^{2} \mu_{1}^{2} - i E_{1} TVp_{1} detae_{1 2} k_{1} \mu_{1} - i E_{1} TdT_{1} detae_{1 2} k_{1} \mu_{1} + E_{1} TdTp_{1} detae_{1 2} - i E_{2} TPhi_{2} detae_{1 1} k_{2} \mu_{2} - E_{2} TPhip_{2} detae_{1 1} - E_{2} TV_{2} detae_{1 1} k_{2}^{2} \mu_{2}^{2} - i E_{2} TVp_{2} detae_{1 1} k_{2} \mu_{2} - i E_{2} TdT_{2} detae_{1 1} k_{2} \mu_{2} + E_{2} TdTp_{2} detae_{1 1}
\end{dmath*}
\paragraph{[obs] local / fields:1+1 [obs]}
\begin{dmath*}
E_{1} E_{2} \left(Pperp TV_{1} TV_{2} - 2 TPhi_{1} TPhi_{2} - 2 i TPhi_{1} TV_{2} k_{2} \mu_{2} - 2 i TPhi_{2} TV_{1} k_{1} \mu_{1} + TdT_{1} TdT_{2}\right)
\end{dmath*}
\paragraph{[obs] local / fields:2 [obs]}
\begin{dmath*}
- \frac{EK \left(- K^{2} \left(2 i Kn V_{2} + Kom_{12} k_{1} \mu_{1} + Kom_{21} k_{2} \mu_{2} + KvT_{12} k_{1} \mu_{1} + KvT_{21} k_{2} \mu_{2} + 2 \Psi_{2} - 2 dT_{2}\right) + Kn Kom_{12} k_{1}^{2} + Kn Kom_{12} k_{1} k_{2} \mu + Kn Kom_{21} k_{1} k_{2} \mu + Kn Kom_{21} k_{2}^{2} + Kn KvT_{12} k_{1}^{2} + Kn KvT_{12} k_{1} k_{2} \mu + Kn KvT_{21} k_{1} k_{2} \mu + Kn KvT_{21} k_{2}^{2}\right)}{2 K^{2}}
\end{dmath*}
\paragraph{[obs] observer displacement / fields:1 [obs]}
\begin{dmath*}
- E_{1} Pperp TPhi_{1} Xo_{2} - i E_{1} Pperp TV_{1} Xo_{2} k_{1} \mu_{1} + E_{1} Pperp TdT_{1} Xo_{2} - E_{1} TPhi_{1} Xo_{2} k_{1} k_{2} \mu_{1} \mu_{2} - i E_{1} TV_{1} Xo_{2} k_{1}^{2} k_{2} \mu_{1}^{2} \mu_{2} + E_{1} TdT_{1} Xo_{2} k_{1} k_{2} \mu_{1} \mu_{2} - E_{2} Pperp TPhi_{2} Xo_{1} - i E_{2} Pperp TV_{2} Xo_{1} k_{2} \mu_{2} + E_{2} Pperp TdT_{2} Xo_{1} - E_{2} TPhi_{2} Xo_{1} k_{1} k_{2} \mu_{1} \mu_{2} - i E_{2} TV_{2} Xo_{1} k_{1} k_{2}^{2} \mu_{1} \mu_{2}^{2} + E_{2} TdT_{2} Xo_{1} k_{1} k_{2} \mu_{1} \mu_{2}
\end{dmath*}
\paragraph{[emi] local / fields:1+1 [emi]}
\begin{dmath*}
E_{1} E_{2} \left(Pperp TV_{1} TV_{2} + 2 TPhi_{1} TPhi_{2} + 2 i TPhi_{1} TV_{2} k_{2} \mu_{2} + 2 i TPhi_{2} TV_{1} k_{1} \mu_{1} - TdT_{1} TdT_{2}\right)
\end{dmath*}
\paragraph{[emi] local / fields:2 [emi]}
\begin{dmath*}
\frac{EK \left(K^{2} \left(- 2 i Kn V_{2} - Kom_{12} k_{1} \mu_{1} - Kom_{21} k_{2} \mu_{2} - KvT_{12} k_{1} \mu_{1} - KvT_{21} k_{2} \mu_{2} - 2 \Psi_{2} + 2 dT_{2}\right) + Kn Kom_{12} k_{1}^{2} + Kn Kom_{12} k_{1} k_{2} \mu + Kn Kom_{21} k_{1} k_{2} \mu + Kn Kom_{21} k_{2}^{2} + Kn KvT_{12} k_{1}^{2} + Kn KvT_{12} k_{1} k_{2} \mu + Kn KvT_{21} k_{1} k_{2} \mu + Kn KvT_{21} k_{2}^{2}\right)}{2 K^{2}}
\end{dmath*}
\paragraph{[emi] lensing (transverse Dx1) / fields:1 [emi]}
\begin{dmath*}
Pperp \left(Dp_{1} E_{2} TPhi_{2} + i Dp_{1} E_{2} TV_{2} k_{2} \mu_{2} - Dp_{1} E_{2} TdT_{2} + Dp_{2} E_{1} TPhi_{1} + i Dp_{2} E_{1} TV_{1} k_{1} \mu_{1} - Dp_{2} E_{1} TdT_{1}\right)
\end{dmath*}
\paragraph{[emi] time delay (radial Dx1) / fields:1 [emi]}
\begin{dmath*}
- i Dz_{1} E_{2} TPhi_{2} k_{2} \mu_{2} + Dz_{1} E_{2} TV_{2} k_{2}^{2} \mu_{2}^{2} + i Dz_{1} E_{2} TdT_{2} k_{2} \mu_{2} - i Dz_{2} E_{1} TPhi_{1} k_{1} \mu_{1} + Dz_{2} E_{1} TV_{1} k_{1}^{2} \mu_{1}^{2} + i Dz_{2} E_{1} TdT_{1} k_{1} \mu_{1}
\end{dmath*}
\paragraph{[emi] transverse direction k1 (aberration+deflection) / fields:1 [emi]}
\begin{dmath*}
- Pperp \left(E_{1} Kf_{2} TV_{1} + E_{2} Kf_{1} TV_{2}\right)
\end{dmath*}
\paragraph{B channels} $K_1(k_1)K_1(k_2) - \Delta_0(k_1)K_1(k_2) - \Delta_0(k_2)K_1(k_1)$.
